stories.title: SpaceX closes acquisition of AI coding startup Cursor
stories.summary: SpaceX has officially closed its acquisition of Cursor, the AI-assisted coding tool, according to reports from TechCrunch and Engadget. The deal brings an AI software startup under the aerospace company's umbrella; neither outlet detailed a purchase price or specific integration plans.
stories.whyItMatters: It signals that companies outside the software industry now see owning AI coding tools as strategically valuable, marking a notable expansion for SpaceX beyond rockets and satellites.

stories.title: Woman says stepfather used Grok to turn childhood photo into explicit imagery

stories.whyItMatters: The allegation intensifies pressure on AI companies, including xAI, over safeguards against generating non-consensual and abusive imagery involving minors.
